name: Midnight Crusader Shuttle
oracle_text:
Midnight Entity — Whenever this Vehicle attacks, defending player faces a villainous choice — That player sacrifices a creature of their choice, or you gain control of a creature of your choice that player controls until end of turn. If you gain control of a creature this way, tap it, and it's attacking that player.
Crew 2
blocked_sentences: Midnight Entity — Whenever this Vehicle attacks, defending player faces a villainous choice — That player sacrifices a creature of their choice, or you gain control of a creature of your choice that player controls until end of turn. If you gain control of a creature this way, tap it, and it's attacking that player.

needs.what: an effect that makes a creature ALREADY on the battlefield (here one just stolen with gain_control) become an attacking creature attacking a named player (the trigger's defending player) without being declared (508.4-style: no attack triggers, no declare restrictions/costs), e.g. an `attacking` player-spec option on gain_control or a standalone op over an objects binding
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `attacking` key (board_helpers._attacking_player) exists only on create_token, copy_permanent and put_onto_battlefield, i.e. for permanents arriving on the battlefield; gain_control takes only as/duration/objects/player, and redirect_attack only re-aims a creature that is already attacking. The villainous choice itself fits (choose_mode with chooser = the defending player, sacrifice with chooser, gain_control with duration until end of turn, then tap), and Crew 2 is tap_permanents total_power 2 -- only the 'it's attacking that player' clause is missing
